intro: This service needs no database: it downloads an image from a URL and resizes it. The database setup in the README comes from the microservice template, and the repo has no migrations.
prerequisites: Node.js 16 and npm. CI tests on Node 16.

steps.title: Run the tests
steps.text: These are the CI checks. The tests mock the image download, so they need no network access.

steps.title: Start the server
steps.text: The server listens on http://localhost:3006, and `/` returns the version. To resize an image, request `/img/<image host>/<options>/<image path>`. The options are `w` and `h` (pixels), `r` (rotation in degrees), and `q` (JPEG quality, 1 to 100), for example `w=100,h=50`. The server gets the image from `https://<image host>/<image path>` and returns a JPEG.
